monthly_policy: train labels ending at or before previous calendar month-end; model assigned by forecast origin month
primary_cohort: all 2026 eligible Vietcap origin/target pairs; frozen control re-scored on same cohort
secondary_cohort: same 200 common Yahoo/Vietcap pairs as previous evaluation
forward_bundle: shadow only; refit through latest matured target, frozen calibration snapshot until manually rebuilt
full_session_forward_rule: issued local calendar date strictly before realized next positive-volume target date
role: adaptive retrospective diagnosis on already inspected 2026; monthly time-order simulation is not fresh independent out-of-sample evidence; adjusted source not point-in-time certified
